newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin congratulates Romania's new president.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin congratulates Romania's new president.

text.p: President Boris Yeltsin on Tuesday congratulated Emil Constantinescu on his victory in Romania's presidential election, which ended seven years of rule by ex-communists following dictator Nicolae Ceausescu's ouster.
"In Boris Yeltsin's message he expresses hope for the further development of ties between Russia and Romania," Itar-Tass news agency said.
The victory of Constantinescu, who beat Moscow-educated incumbent Ion Iliescu in Sunday's poll on promises to speed up market reforms, has been widely welcomed by the West.
